name: Field
lead: A number at every block, as a recipe the engine works out. Sums (`+ - * / ^` and unary minus) and the methods make new fields; a plain number is a field too. A field above 0.5 is "true" where a rule asks a question.

functions.name: gt
functions.description: 1 where this is the larger, else 0.

functions.name: lt
functions.description: 1 where this is the smaller, else 0.

functions.name: smooth
functions.description: 0 at `from`, 1 at `to`, smooth between. `from` may be the larger.

functions.name: curve
functions.description: Straight lines through `{ { input, output }, ... }`, inputs rising.

functions.name: at
functions.signature: field:at(dx: number, dy: number, dz: number) → Field
functions.description: This field read `dx, dy, dz` blocks away: `fields.water:at(1, 0, 0)` is the water east of here.
